24UCBP10 DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGIES L/T/P/C
3/0/0/3
Nature of Course: Theory PEC
Prerequisite(s):Basic understanding of marketing concepts, Familiarity with internet and social media
platforms ,Familiarity with digital tools and web technologies.
Course Objectives: Enable the students to
Analyze the concepts of SEO, email marketing, and social media marketing to support the
promotion of brands, products, and services in the digital environment.
Design data-driven marketing frameworks that incorporate personalized campaigns and
emerging technologies to optimize customer reach and business growth in the digital
space.

Course Contents:
UNIT I INTRODUCTION TO ONLINE MARKET CO1 9
Online Market space- Digital Marketing Strategy- Components -Opportunities for building Brand, Website
- Planning and Creation- Content Marketing

UNIT II SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMISATION CO2 9
Search Engine optimization - Keyword Strategy- SEO Strategy - SEO success factors -On-Page
Techniques - Off-Page Techniques. Search Engine Marketing- How Search Engine works- SEM
components- PPC advertising -Display Advertisement

UNIT III E- MAIL MARKETING CO3 9
E- Mail Marketing - Types of E- Mail Marketing - Email Automation - Lead Generation - Integrating Email
with Social Media and Mobile- Measuring and maximizing email campaign effectiveness. Mobile
Marketing- Mobile Inventory/channels- Location based; Context based; Coupons and offers, Mobile
Apps, Mobile Commerce, SMS Campaigns-Profiling and targeting

UNIT IV SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING CO4 9
Social Media Marketing - Social Media Channels- Leveraging Social media for brand conversations and
buzz. Successful /benchmark Social media campaigns. Engagement Marketing- Building Customer
relationships - Creating Loyalty drivers - Influencer Marketing

UNIT V DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION CO5 9
Digital Transformation & Channel Attribution- Analytics- Ad-words, Email, Mobile, Social Media, Web
Analytics - Changing your strategy based on analysis- Recent trends in Digital marketing

Theory Hours: 45

COURSE OUTCOMES
At the end of the course student will be able to
CO 1 Differentiate various digital commerce models and marketing strategies used in online business environments.
CO 2 Implement Search Engine Optimization (SEO) techniques to improve a website's visibility on search engines.
CO 3 Analyze the effectiveness of email marketing by examining its role in customer engagement, lead generation, and brand promotion.
CO 4 Evaluate the impact of content creation and distribution across social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
CO 5 Design innovative strategies by integrating emerging technologies to transform business operations and enhance customer engagement.

Text Books:
1 Dave Chaffey & Fiona Ellis-Chadwick, Digital Marketing: Strategy, Implementation & Practice, 8th Edition, Pearson, 2022
2 Philip Kotler, Hermawan Kartajaya & Iwan Setiawan, Marketing 5.0: Technology for Humanity, 1st Edition, Wiley, 2021

Reference Books:
1 Philip Kotler, Hermawan Kartajaya & Iwan Setiawan, Marketing 5.0, Wiley, 2021
2 Gary Vaynerchuk, Jab, Jab, Jab, Right Hook, Harper Business, 2023
